endpoint: self-hosted Qwen3.5-4B on a single GPU
provenance: Produced by the original verification run (Qwen3.5-4B on vLLM, guided JSON decoding, thinking disabled), on the same 200 scenarios and the same system prompt as the managed and Luna runs in this repo. Summary carried over from that run; not re-executed by bench/bench_vllm.py here. bench/bench_vllm.py reproduces this measurement against any vLLM endpoint. Latency is a self-hosted GPU at a different time and is not comparable to the Bedrock latencies as a serving benchmark.

qwen3.5-4b.note: Served with guided JSON decoding, so schema_ok is 200/200 by construction; the managed backends are prompt-only, which favors Qwen on tools_match. arg_accuracy is the coarse key-presence measure defined in bench_vllm.py.
